scripts.staging:up: npm run build:staging && docker compose -p zhimu-staging -f docker-compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging up -d --build
scripts.staging:rebuild-api: docker compose -p zhimu-staging -f docker-compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging build --no-cache api && docker compose -p zhimu-staging -f docker-compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging up -d api && docker compose -p zhimu-staging -f docker-compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging exec api sh -c "node scripts/migrate.js && node scripts/ensure-platform-catalog.js"
scripts.staging:logs: docker compose -p zhimu-staging -f docker-compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging logs -f api
scripts.staging:seed: docker compose -p zhimu-staging -f docker-compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging exec api node scripts/seed.js
scripts.staging:catalog: docker compose -p zhimu-staging -f docker-compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging exec api node scripts/ensure-platform-catalog.js
scripts.staging:cleanup-rooms: docker compose -p zhimu-staging -f docker-compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging exec api node scripts/cleanup-duplicate-rooms.js
